animation.notes: Verified on a Pixoo 64 (hardware 92) on 2026-10-04, camera-timed. FiestaBoard SNAPS on this device: maxFps 2 is the verified safe still-push rate, below every LED transition's minimum, so the resolved transition is none and preview and device both cut. Why not animate: Draw/SendHttpGif uploads (one POST per frame, ~190 ms each, PicNum frames, PicOffset index, PicSpeed ms per frame, PicData base64 RGB888 row-major from the top left, PicWidth 64) LOOP FOREVER with no play-once flag; any upload longer than ~1.2 s (more than ~3 frames) shows a LOADING overlay from ~1.5 s after the first POST until ~0.5 s after the last (8 frames 1.3 s, 32 frames 4.8 s, 40 frames 6.3 s); landing on a still after an animation keeps the old loop running with frame 0 replaced for ~5 s. A single-frame push shows in ~0.5 s with no overlay. Frame cap: 59 frames were accepted but playback wrapped at ~55 (frames 55+ silently dropped); 40 played completely, so an explicit multi-frame upload should stay at 40 frames or fewer. Push spacing: 20 single-frame pushes at 1.0 s and 0.5 s all displayed in order. PicID: an upload displays only if PicID > the last accepted one (skipping ahead is fine); a reused or lower PicID still answers error_code 0 but is silently ignored, so error_code 0 means accepted, not shown. Draw/GetHttpGifId returns the next id (0 right after a reset). Draw/ResetHttpGifId does not clear the screen and needs no wait afterwards. Not verified: the community report of a freeze after ~300 pushes without a reset (the lab stayed under 25 ids between resets), and behaviour on other firmware. mDNS: the device advertises nothing.
sources: FiestaBoard hardware lab on a Pixoo 64, 2026-10-04 (camera-timed; fiestaboard-output--divoom-pixoo PR #1)
